title: Elections - Jefferson County Iowa Government
text:
Elections - Jefferson County Iowa Government Notice: County Courthouse Offices will be closed Thursday, December 25th and Friday, December 26, 2025 for Christmas. Call ahead for individual office hours on Wednesday, December 24th.
Jefferson County 2024 General Election results: https://electionresults.iowa.gov/IA/Jefferson/122373/
Notice: County Courthouse Offices will be closed Memorial Day, Monday, May 25, 2026.
Notice: County Courthouse Offices will be closed New Year's Day, Friday, January 1, 2027.
Notice: County Courthouse Offices will be closed Monday, February 15th, 2027 for President's Day.
Notice: County Courthouse Offices will be closed Friday, July 3rd, 2026 in observance of Independence Day.
Notice: County Courthouse Offices will be closed Monday, September 7th, 2026 for Labor Day.
Notice: County Courthouse Offices will be closed Wednesday, November 11th, 2026 for Veterans Day.
Notice: County Courthouse Offices will be closed Thursday, November 26th and Friday, November 27, 2026 for Thanksgiving.
Notice: County Courthouse Offices will be closed Friday, December 25th, 2026 for Christmas.
Notice: County Courthouse Offices will be closing at 2:00 P.M. on Monday, October 12th, 2026 for employee safety training.
Permanent Polling Location Change: Fairfield 2nd Ward will vote at the County Engineer's Office, 901 N 8th St., Fairfield.
Permanent Polling Location Change: Fairfield 5th Ward will vote at the Friends Church, 1209 S. 6th St., Fairfield.

Notice of Election
Click here for Notice of Election
Voter Registration
Check your voter registration status or register to vote on the Iowa Secretary of State's website.
The pre-registration deadline for this election is October 19, 2026 at 5:00 P.M .
Absentee Voting
In-Office
Absentee voting will be available beginning Wednesday, October 14th in the Jefferson County Election Office on the main floor of the Jefferson County Courthouse, 51 E. Briggs Ave., Fairfield.
Office hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 A.M. - 4:30 P.M.
Open until 5:00 P.M.: October 19 & 30, 2026
Open Saturday: October 31, 2026, 9:00 A.M. - 5:00 P.M.
Last day to vote absentee in office: November 2, 2026
By Mail
Requests to mail an absentee ballot must be received by October 19, 2026 at 5:00 P.M .
An absentee ballot request form is available on the Iowa Secretary of State's website.
Send completed form to:
Jefferson County Auditor
51 E. Briggs Ave.
Fairfield, Iowa 52556
The first day absentee ballots can be mailed out is October 14, 2026 .
